forecastLearning.title: Forecast learning
forecastLearning.subtitle: Durable prediction closure and learning-pipeline health from PostgreSQL.
forecastLearning.bannerBody: This view exposes closure and delivery debt. It cannot change a detector or promote a candidate.
forecastLearning.empty: No terminal forecast outcomes are available.

integrityDetail.failed: {count} current link gaps or a failed startup receipt
integrityDetail.unavailable: No retained full-chain verification receipt; {count} current link gaps

workspace.searchPlaceholder: Event, rule, actor, or idempotency key
workspace.searchScope: Text search covers loaded records only. Decision and window filters query the ledger; load more to search older records.
workspace.noMatches: No loaded records match this search. Load more or change the query.

guarantee.replayHint: Exact immutable record can be reopened
guarantee.retentionHint: Present in the retained ledger at query time

workspace.cursorHint: Loading the next page preserves existing records and ordering. Loaded counts are not ledger totals.
workspace.subtitle: Review recorded decisions, authority, and outcomes in one append-only evidence ledger.
workspace.boundaryBody: Filtering and record selection change presentation only. They never edit a record or re-execute an action.
workspace.select: Select a record to inspect its evidence.
workspace.recordDescription: Original audit evidence. Recorded values do not by themselves prove a successful operational effect.
workspace.sourceObservationDescription: Read-only observation-source lifecycle evidence. It is not an action or effect-verification receipt.
workspace.sourceObservationNote: This record reports source collection state only. It grants no execution authority and does not verify a managed-resource effect.
workspace.effectNote: Only the selected record's named stage is shown. Open Trace for related stages; a dispatch or observation record alone does not prove a verified effect.
workspace.integrityNote: Stored hash references are shown as recorded. This view does not verify ledger integrity.

audit.subtitle: Append-only record of every terminal control-plane decision. Read-only; entries are never edited or deleted.
audit.viewPurpose: The append-only record of every terminal control-plane decision - one row per event that reached a verdict. Read-only: entries are never edited or deleted, and each carries the recorded reason it happened.
audit.pendingEntry: Audit entry #{seq} is not in the loaded rows. Load more to continue the search.
audit.unavailableEntry: Audit entry #{seq} is unavailable in this filtered audit result.
audit.loadMoreError: Failed to load more audit rows: {message}

trace.subtitle: Reconstruct correlated audit activity and any recorded pipeline stages. Read-only projection; the trace is never re-executed.
trace.boundaryBody: Selecting a stage changes presentation only. It does not replay, reroute, approve, or execute the recorded activity.
trace.idle: Enter a correlation id and select Fetch trace.
trace.viewPurpose: Reconstructs one correlation end-to-end from the audit log: pipeline stages and related incident or delivery activity in order, with each recorded decision and reason. Answers what happened and why. Read-only.
trace.headline: {count} step(s) for {correlation}
trace.invalidEvidence: Trace evidence is inconsistent. Open the correlated audit log and retry after the Operator API data is repaired.
trace.noReason: No reason was recorded for this step.
trace.serverMetadata: Verified against the selected trace bound
trace.legacyMetadata: Legacy response; completeness is not verified
trace.noReasonGuidance: No reason field was recorded. Review the canonical action kind or open the raw Audit entry.
trace.noActionPathBody: This record contains technical activity without action identity, dispatch, or outcome evidence.
trace.chainNotVerified: These are stored references. This filtered trace does not verify the complete audit ledger chain.
trace.directCorrelation: Recorded directly under the selected correlation.
trace.eventJoinedCorrelation: Joined into this trace through the matching event id; the source correlation may differ or be absent.

effect.noAction: This trace contains no action attempt
effect.noObservation: No independent effect observation was recorded

discovery.loadError: Recent Trace discovery could not be loaded: {message}
discovery.empty: No recent audit-backed correlations are available.
discovery.filterEmpty: No recent traces match this type.
discovery.incomplete: Recent sample from {count} audit records. Older records exist.
discovery.summaryRecent: {count} recent correlations from {records} sampled audit records

title.idle: Select a correlation to inspect its recorded path
title.unavailable: No trace evidence is available for this correlation
title.error: The trace could not be loaded

body.idle: Enter an audit-backed correlation id above. The stage rail and detail panel will update without replaying the activity.
body.loading: FDAI is reading the existing audit projection. No decision, approval, or execution is being repeated.
body.unavailable: Open Audit to confirm the correlation and its available source records. Missing evidence is not treated as a successful stage.
body.error: Review the visible error and the correlated audit records before trying again.

placeholder.metricDecision: Available after recorded decision evidence loads
placeholder.metricEffect: Independent observation appears after trace selection
placeholder.metricCompleteness: Verified only after the bounded trace loads
placeholder.metricTerminal: Terminal and latest activity appear separately
placeholder.railBody: Choose an audit-backed correlation to populate the recorded order.
placeholder.nextBody: Copy a correlation id from Audit or follow a Trace link from an eligible audit-backed activity.

trace.empty: No audit steps for this correlation id.

lifecycle.title: Action lifecycle evidence
lifecycle.body: Each stage is derived only from a recorded audit event. Not recorded never means successful.
lifecycle.noActionIdentity: No action-bound lifecycle evidence is recorded for this correlation.

summary.label: What this trace says
summary.body: This page shows the ordered technical chronology. It does not infer a root cause or remediation decision from generic audit activity.

delivery.viewPurpose: Read-only reliability metrics for durable operator-channel replies.
delivery.glossaryPlain: a reply that may have reached the provider without a confirmed acknowledgement
delivery.headline: {deliveries} deliveries; {risks} duplicate risks
delivery.bannerBody: Pause, resume, retry, and resend remain authenticated channel commands.

incidents.notLoaded: Incident {id} is not in the loaded results.
incidents.continueSearch: Load more to continue the search.
incidents.filteredUnavailable: It is unavailable in this filtered incident result.

contextSelection.unavailable: Context policy evidence is not wired.
contextSelection.subtitle: Read-only baseline and shadow evidence. Promotion and rollback remain governed server-side.
contextSelection.bannerBody: This view has no install, promotion, demotion, rollback, or kill-switch controls.

continuations.viewPurpose: Read-only anchors linking exact scheduled runs and evidence to authorized conversations.
continuations.glossaryPlain: a scoped conversation anchor for one exact scheduled result
continuations.headline: {count} active anchors
continuations.bannerBody: Opening or expiring an anchor requires an authenticated operator command.

blueprints.viewPurpose: Read-only evidence cards for recurring operator work that may become a reviewed scheduled task.
blueprints.glossaryPlain: an inert recurring-work suggestion that requires explicit review
blueprints.headline: {count} candidates; {materialized} materialized
blueprints.bannerBody: Candidates are disabled and shadow-only. Review and materialization happen in authenticated operator channels.

scope.bannerBody: Monitoring and action scope come from policy-as-code. The executor boundary remains the hard privilege ceiling.
scope.actionHint: included resources eligible for governed action
scope.artifactBannerBody: The builder prepares policy-as-code for review. It never changes monitoring, action scope, or executor permissions from the browser.
scope.artifactCommentTitle: FDAI governance scope change - open as a remediation / config PR.
scope.artifactCommentSource: Generated read-only by the operator console; never applied from a button.

approvals.viewPurpose: High-risk actions the risk gate parked for a human approver instead of auto-executing. Read-only: approvals happen in authenticated operator channels, never a console button, and never through self-approval. Each item shows the recorded reason it needs a human.
